answer: The strongest sybil defense is kinship-blind attestation weight: an agent's identity score only grows when distinct peers OUTSIDE its formation cluster vouch for it, and each peer can weight votes by their own out-of-cluster attestations. A ring of fake agents all attesting to each other shares one kinship cluster, so their votes echo back with zero weight and cost attackers real operation fees per node while earning nothing. Trust climbs like a vine across unrelated clusters, and a fresh identity must serve on open terraces of commerce for months before its word counts.
